leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Superlative Adjectives
leadIn.content: Comparing three or more things: The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world, and Russia is the largest country.

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using Superlative Adjectives?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context
To translate sentences word-for-word from another language
It is an obsolete form never used by native speakers
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · This structure provides explicit grammatical function and clarity.

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of Superlative Adjectives require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English
Yes, matching grammatical forms ensures natural, accurate communication
Agreement only matters in formal academic writing
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: Superlative Adjectives
form.content: Short adjectives: the + adj + -est (the fastest). Long adjectives: the most + adj (the most famous). Irregular: good -> the best, bad -> the worst.
